title: WaterColor Sea Breeze
meta_description: WaterColor Phase 1 - Walk to Beach Club and Seaside Village!
description_expanded: Description: WaterColor Sea Breeze by Royal Destinations Location: 9 Lyonia Lane Details: Welcome to Sea Breeze, an inviting WaterColor retreat ideally situated in the highly desirable Tennis District of WaterColor’s Phase I. Surrounded by the charm, natural beauty, and exceptional amenities that make WaterColor one of 30A’s most sought-after communities, this four-bedroom residence offers an effortless setting for an elevated coastal getaway. Located just moments from WaterColor’s tennis facilities and within walking or biking distance of Seaside, the WaterColor Beach Club, acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, and the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, Sea Breeze places guests in the heart of the 30A experience while providing a comfortable retreat to return to at the end of the day. With accommodations for up to 10 guests, thoughtfully arranged bedrooms, inviting porches, four adult bikes, and access to WaterColor’s exceptional resort amenities, the home is beautifully suited for families and groups looking to experience 30A at its best. Designed for relaxed coastal living, Sea Breeze offers comfortable gathering spaces balanced by private retreats across two levels. The main living area provides a welcoming place to unwind after a day at the beach, with a large wall-mounted flat-screen television and Apple TV for relaxed evenings at home. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the residence. The home’s outdoor spaces extend the living experience beyond the interiors, while a gas grill makes casual dinners at home an easy option. The first-floor features two well-appointed bedrooms, including the primary suite with a king bed, private bathroom, and direct porch access. A second guest suite offers a queen bed and its own connecting bathroom. Upstairs, guests will find an additional king bedroom along with a charming bunk room featuring two twin-over-twin bunk beds—an ideal arrangement for children or younger guests. These bedrooms share a beautifully updated bathroom featuring a spacious walk-in shower with a rainfall showerhead.
